name: Cultivation Module - Feature Showcase
author: Built-in Tutorial
description: Demonstrates each module feature one by one; each event's note is a single sentence about what it does.
note: Tutorial module: each event, variable and plugin demonstrates exactly one feature, and its note says what that feature does.

info.content: Feature showcase: each event demonstrates one feature and explains what it does to the player in a sentence or two. There is no story.

variables.name: Qi
variables.generalRules: Number variable: 0 to 100. <var|Qi|add|10> adds or subtracts; <rule|Qi|Meditate> adds 10.

variables.name: Sect
variables.generalRules: Text variable: set it with <var|Sect|set|Eastern Mountain Sect>; at most 8 characters.

variables.name: Initiated
variables.generalRules: Boolean variable: only yes or no; change it with <var|Initiated|set|true>.

variables.name: Bag
variables.generalRules: List variable: append adds an item, remove removes one.

variables.name: Profile
variables.generalRules: Object variable: modify_item changes one of its fields.

variables.name: Friends
variables.generalRules: Object-list variable: add_item adds an entry, modify_item changes one.

variables.name: Realm
variables.generalRules: Built-in variable: computed automatically from Qi; the AI cannot change it.

variables.name: Comprehension
variables.generalRules: Switch variable: only sent to the AI when the event carries the switch demo tag.

variables.name: Spirit Root
variables.generalRules: Read-only variable: the AI can see it but cannot modify it.

variables.name: Scratch
variables.generalRules: Temporary variable: not sent to the AI; reserved for plugins.

plugins.name: Variable Panel
plugins.note: Display plugin: read-only display of Qi and Realm.
plugins.inlineHtml:
Qi
Realm

subModules.name: Event Structure
subModules.note: Parent event: groups related child events together.

subModules.name: Trigger Chain
subModules.note: Trigger chain: events run in order; the previous one must finish before the next can start.

info.content: Trigger chain: events run in order; the previous one must finish before the next can start.

subModules.name: Next Step in the Chain
subModules.note: The next event in the chain; it can only be entered after the previous one is completed.

info.content: The next event in the chain; it can only be entered after the previous one is completed.

subModules.name: Free Trigger
subModules.note: Free trigger: no fixed order; can be entered any time its conditions are met.

info.content: Free trigger: no fixed order; can be entered any time its conditions are met.

subModules.name: Sub-flow Entry
subModules.note: Sub-flow entry: events in the sub-flow can only be entered after this one is completed.

info.content: Sub-flow entry: events in the sub-flow can only be entered after this one is completed.

subModules.name: Time
subModules.note: Time: the module defines how years, months, days, hours and minutes advance and are displayed.

subModules.name: Time System
subModules.note: Time system: sets year/month/day/hour/minute and the display format; the AI advances time with <time|hour|add|2>.

info.content: Time system: sets year/month/day/hour/minute and the display format; the AI advances time with <time|hour|add|2>.

subModules.name: Computed Parameter
subModules.note: Computed parameter: the double-hour is derived from the hour automatically and cannot be modified directly.

info.content: Computed parameter: the double-hour is derived from the hour automatically and cannot be modified directly.

subModules.name: Time Carry-over
subModules.note: Time carry-over: sets days per month and months per year; here every month has 30 days.

info.content: Time carry-over: sets days per month and months per year; here every month has 30 days.

subModules.name: Timeline
subModules.note: Timeline: can only be entered once the specified time arrives; it must carry a time condition.

info.content: Timeline: can only be entered once the specified time arrives; it must carry a time condition.

subModules.name: Conditions
subModules.note: Conditions: control when an event can be entered and when it can be completed.

subModules.name: Completion Condition
subModules.note: Completion condition: the event can only be completed once it is met; here Initiated must be yes.

info.content: Completion condition: the event can only be completed once it is met; here Initiated must be yes.

subModules.name: Event State Condition
subModules.note: Event state condition: checks whether another event has been entered or completed.

info.content: Event state condition: checks whether another event has been entered or completed.

subModules.name: Entry Condition
subModules.note: Entry condition: must be met to enter; here Qi must be at least 10.

info.content: Entry condition: must be met to enter; here Qi must be at least 10.

subModules.name: Variable Comparison Condition
subModules.note: Variable comparison condition: compares two variables against each other; here Qi must be at least Comprehension.

info.content: Variable comparison condition: compares two variables against each other; here Qi must be at least Comprehension.

subModules.name: Time Condition
subModules.note: Time condition: met only once the specified date arrives.

info.content: Time condition: met only once the specified date arrives.

subModules.name: Relative Time Condition
subModules.note: Relative time condition: met some time after another event is completed.

info.content: Relative time condition: met some time after another event is completed.

subModules.name: Tag Condition
subModules.note: Tag condition: checks whether an active event carries a specified tag.

info.content: Tag condition: checks whether an active event carries a specified tag.

subModules.name: Condition Combination
subModules.note: Condition combination: nests multiple conditions with AND / OR.

info.content: Condition combination: nests multiple conditions with AND / OR.

subModules.name: Variables
subModules.note: Variables: an event can define variables and can also set variables on entry.

subModules.name: Set Variables on Entry
subModules.note: Set variables on entry: when jumped into from the debug page, Sect is automatically set to Eastern Mountain Sect.

info.content: Set variables on entry: when jumped into from the debug page, Sect is automatically set to Eastern Mountain Sect.

subModules.name: Scoped Variable
subModules.note: Scoped variable: a variable defined in an event is only visible in that event and its child events.

info.content: Scoped variable: a variable defined in an event is only visible in that event and its child events.

variables.name: Aura
variables.generalRules: Scope demo: only visible inside the scoped variable event.

subModules.name: Switch Variable
subModules.note: Switch variable: Comprehension is only sent to the AI while an event with the switch demo tag is active.

info.content: Switch variable: Comprehension is only sent to the AI while an event with the switch demo tag is active.

subModules.name: Persistent Background
subModules.note: Persistent background: background marked persistent is still sent to the AI after entering child events.

info.content: Persistent background: this entry is also sent while child events are active.
This-event background: this entry is only sent while this event itself is active.

subModules.name: Background
subModules.note: Background: text sent to the AI while the event is active; it can carry conditions.

info.content: Background: this entry is always sent while this event is active.
Conditional background: this entry is only sent when Qi is at least 10.

subModules.name: Delivery
subModules.note: Delivery: information the AI must acknowledge; the event cannot be completed before it is confirmed.

info.content: Delivery: information the AI must acknowledge; the event cannot be completed before it is confirmed.

deliveryInfo.title: Confirm Delivery
deliveryInfo.content: Delivery: this entry must be confirmed by the AI with <delivery|Confirm Delivery|done>.

deliveryInfo.title: Conditional Delivery
deliveryInfo.content: Conditional delivery: confirmation is only required when Qi is at least 10.

subModules.name: Queue Display
subModules.note: Queue display: controls how many upcoming event names are listed in the prompt.

info.content: Queue display: controls how many upcoming event names are listed in the prompt.

subModules.name: Calendar Background
subModules.note: Calendar background: background can be sent only during a date range or at certain hours each day.

info.content: Date background: only sent from Year 1, Month 1, Day 1 to Day 10.
Hour background: sent every day between 6:00 and 18:00.

subModules.name: Event Summary
subModules.note: Event summary: when child events are completed, the AI is asked to write a summary for this parent event.

promptList.content: Summarize this group of events in one sentence.

subModules.name: Summarized Event
subModules.note: Completing it triggers the summary of its parent event.

info.content: Completing it triggers the summary of its parent event.

subModules.name: Plugins
subModules.note: Plugins: small panels attached to a module or event and shown in the sidebar.

subModules.name: Display Plugin
subModules.note: Display plugin: shows variables read-only; here it shows Qi and Realm.

info.content: Display plugin: shows variables read-only; here it shows Qi and Realm.

subModules.name: Event in the Sub-flow
subModules.note: Sub-flow: another line running in parallel with the main line; this is one of its events.

info.content: Sub-flow: another line running in parallel with the main line; this is one of its events.
